title: Build SentenceReadingScreen
description: Create app/screens/SentenceReadingScreen.tsx. Shows sentence groups (A then B). Each sentence: display with KaraokeText, speaker button for full sentence TTS, then comprehension question (3-choice MCQ). Track progress per group. Completing all sentences in a group: award coins (10), unlock next group. Use useProgress to check unlock state and save completion. Mascot reactions on correct/wrong answers.

title: Sentence Reading
description: Sentence reading with word-by-word karaoke highlight and comprehension questions

title: Create KaraokeText component
description: Create components/KaraokeText.tsx. Renders a sentence as a row of tappable word blocks. When playing audio, highlights words sequentially using Reanimated color interpolation (gray -> active color -> gray). Tap individual word: speak it via TTS + highlight it. Accept props: words array, onWordTap callback, isPlaying boolean, activeWordIndex. Use useAnimatedStyle for smooth color transitions. Words should wrap naturally on multiple lines.

title: Add sentence data to readingContent.ts
description: Add sentences export to app/constants/readingContent.ts. Two groups (A and B). Group A: 5 simple 3-4 word sentences. Group B: 5 longer 5-6 word sentences. Each sentence has: text, words array, comprehension question (text + 3 options + correct answer index). Group A unlocks after matra level 5 (ऊ). Group B unlocks after completing Group A. Use device TTS for audio (no pre-generated files yet).

title: Create StarRating animated component
description: Create components/StarRating.tsx. Displays 3 stars. Accept 'stars' prop (0-3). When stars prop changes, animate each star sequentially: scale from 0 to 1 with spring + rotate, filled stars in gold, empty stars in gray outline. Use Reanimated withDelay + withSpring for staggered fill animation.

title: Create MascotBadge floating component
description: Create components/MascotBadge.tsx. Small floating badge in top-right corner showing mini mascot + current streak count. Tapping navigates to AvatarScreen. Uses useStreak hook for streak count. Position: absolute, top-right with safe area inset. Shows a small fire emoji next to streak number when streak >= 3. Subtle idle bounce animation on the mascot.

title: Create Confetti particle component
description: Create components/Confetti.tsx. 20-30 SVG particles (circles and small rects) that burst from top of screen. Each particle: random color from cheerful palette, random initial X position, gravity-based Y animation (withTiming with easing), random horizontal drift, fade out near bottom. Expose via ref: confettiRef.current.burst(). Duration ~2 seconds. Uses react-native-reanimated shared values for all particle positions. Renders as an absolute-positioned overlay.

title: Create SVG Mascot component with animations
description: Create components/Mascot.tsx. SVG unicorn using react-native-svg with separate groups for head, body, horn, mane, eyes, mouth. Accept a 'mood' prop: 'idle' | 'happy' | 'sad' | 'celebrate'. Idle: gentle floating via withRepeat + withSequence on translateY. Happy: spring jump + sparkle. Sad: head tilt rotation. Celebrate: side-to-side dance. All animations via react-native-reanimated useSharedValue/useAnimatedStyle. Keep SVG simple — stylized/cute, not detailed. Accept a 'size' prop for different contexts (small badge vs large avatar screen).

title: Create readingContent.ts with matra word data
description: Create app/constants/readingContent.ts with matraLevels array. 10 levels, each with: id, matra character, vowel, name, 8-10 words. Each word has: word string, meaning (English), matra highlight indices. No audio require() yet — TTS will be used initially. No image require() yet — will use emoji placeholders. Include unlock logic: level N unlocks after level N-1 completed with 80%+. Level 1 is always unlocked. Reference spec section 2.1 for word lists.

title: Animated Mascot & Confetti
description: SVG unicorn mascot with Reanimated animations and confetti particle system

title: Build MatraLevelScreen with learn and practice phases
description: Create app/screens/MatraLevelScreen.tsx. Two phases: Learn Phase — full-screen swipeable cards showing each word with matra highlighted in color, meaning below, tap to hear (react-native-tts). Practice Phase — audio plays a word, 4 choices displayed, tap correct one. Track score. On completion show star rating (0-3 stars based on accuracy: <50%=0, 50-69%=1, 70-89%=2, 90-100%=3). Save progress via useProgress hook. Award coins via useCoins (5 per star). Use react-native-gesture-handler for swipe, react-native-reanimated for card transitions.

title: Matra Word Reading Levels
description: 10 progressive matra-based word reading levels with learn and practice phases

title: Build Matra Level Selection screen
description: Create app/screens/MatraLevelListScreen.tsx. Shows all 10 levels as a scrollable list/grid. Each level card shows: level number, matra name (e.g. 'आ की मात्रा'), star rating if completed, lock icon if locked. Tapping unlocked level navigates to MatraLevelScreen with level id as param. Uses useProgress to determine unlock state and star ratings. Locked levels show a subtle lock overlay. Use Reanimated for lock-to-unlock animation when a level becomes available.

title: Create progress hooks (useProgress, useCoins, useStreak)
description: Create app/hooks/useProgress.ts, useCoins.ts, useStreak.ts. useProgress reads/writes level completion data (stars, scores) to AsyncStorage under key 'ira_progress'. useCoins manages coin balance (earn/spend). useStreak tracks daily streak (current, longest, lastPlayedDate). All use AsyncStorage. Data shape matches the spec in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-02-ira-hindi-2nd-standard-levelup-design.md section 3.4.

title: Add Read tab to tab layout
description: Update app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx to add a 4th Read tab (newspaper icon) between Learn and Quiz. Create app/(tabs)/Read.tsx with tile-based layout matching existing tab style (tabTileStyles). Tiles: Matra Words, Sentence Reading, Stories. Each tile routes to its respective screen.

title: Read Tab & Navigation
description: Add 4th 'Read' tab to the app, restructure navigation

title: Implement Word Builder game
description: Replace the stub in app/screens/WordBuilderScreen.tsx. Show a target word (text + TTS audio), display its constituent letters/matras as scrambled draggable tiles at bottom. User drags tiles into correct order in slots at top. Use react-native-gesture-handler PanGesture for drag, Reanimated for snap-to-slot animations. Pull words from matraLevels in readingContent.ts (only from completed levels). Correct completion: confetti + coins (5). Wrong order: tiles shake and reset. 5 words per round.

title: Complete Barakhadi for all 36 consonants
description: Expand the barakhadi array in app/constants/hindiLetters.ts from 5 consonants (क ख ग घ ङ) to all 36 consonants (through ज्ञ). Each consonant needs 13 combinations (अ through अः). The BarakhadiScreen already handles dynamic selection via horizontal scroll — only data needs adding. Follow exact same structure as existing entries.

title: Stories Section
description: Curated Hindi stories with karaoke text and comprehension

title: Complete Existing Stubs
description: Complete Barakhadi for all consonants and implement Word Builder

title: Build StoryListScreen and StoryScreen
description: Create app/screens/StoryListScreen.tsx: grid of story cards showing title, difficulty indicator, lock/unlocked state, 'read' badge if completed. Tapping unlocked story opens StoryScreen. Create app/screens/StoryScreen.tsx: page-by-page reader. Each page shows text via KaraokeText + illustration area (placeholder colored background with emoji for now). Speaker button for page TTS. Swipe or tap to advance pages. After last page: comprehension questions. Completing story awards 15 coins + marks as read in progress.

title: Create story content data
description: Add stories export to app/constants/readingContent.ts. 5 short stories (4-8 sentences each): 1) प्यासा कौआ (Thirsty Crow), 2) शेर और चूहा (Lion and Mouse), 3) लालची कुत्ता (Greedy Dog), 4) चतुर खरगोश (Clever Rabbit), 5) सच्चे दोस्त (True Friends). Each story: id, title, pages array (1-2 sentences per page with words array), comprehension questions (2-3 MCQs), unlock condition (mapped to matra level or sentence group completion). Use simple vocabulary matching the matra levels she's completed by unlock point.

title: Avatar Customization System
description: Avatar screen with shop, equip items, coin spending

title: Build AvatarScreen with shop and equip
description: Create app/screens/AvatarScreen.tsx. Top: large AvatarPreview showing current loadout. Below: category tabs (Hat/Glasses/Wings/Background). Grid of items per category. Each item shows: preview thumbnail, cost, owned checkmark, equipped gold border. Tap unowned item: confirm purchase dialog (spend coins via useCoins). Tap owned item: equip it (save to progress). Coin balance shown prominently at top. Use useProgress to read/write avatar and ownedItems data.

title: Create avatar items data and AvatarPreview component
description: Create app/constants/avatarItems.ts with item definitions: 4 categories (hat, glasses, wings, background), 3-4 items each with id, name, cost, SVG data or style overrides. Create components/AvatarPreview.tsx that renders the mascot SVG with equipped accessories layered on top. Accept equippedItems prop. Each accessory category is an additional SVG group positioned relative to the mascot.
